title: Wavemother's Cloak
summary: The cloak advertises temporary Water Layer Protection.

fields.Damp Aegis: The tooltip advertises Water Layer Protection once per turn in combat, ending when damaged. The pinned passive source reports Damp Aegis is visual only and does not apply that condition.
fields.Advertised condition: Water Layer Protection would grant +2 AC and all saves, Fire resistance and immunity to Burning. These benefits are not verified on the cloak.
fields.Acquisition: Opulent chest behind Allandra Grey’s desk upstairs in the Water Queen’s House.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
